calibration.title: 1. Align video and hall
calibration.explanation: The video lags behind the hall. Play the scene and press “Goal now” exactly when the goal is scored ({{ goal }}). This sets the offset for all scenes.
calibration.noGoal: There is no goal with a tablet shot to set the offset with. You can still choose the scenes.
calibration.hint: “Check” plays the goal scene with the current offset. If the start is missing, lower the offset; if the goal comes too late, raise it. The offset also applies to the chapters in the YouTube video.
